timings.scope: Complete grading network forward, including the unchanged prefix and selected head/block. Identical cached training ROI samples; model load, disk IO, host-to-device transfer, detector and ROI preparation excluded.

common_preprocessing.scope: Synchronized original pipeline includes DICOM load, resampling, detector, exact ROI construction and original grading; model load and file hashing excluded. Grading forward hooks are synchronized. The residual includes localization, ROI and tensor/feature IO, and is not a pure detector benchmark. Failed attempts retained locally.

timings.common_preprocessing_scope: Held-out extraction separately measures common DICOM/localization/ROI and tensor IO; cache construction and model loading are not ordinary classifier inference. Residual timing is not a pure detector benchmark.

interpretation: Test evaluated once after checkpoint selection. Seed standard deviation is not a confidence interval. ROI localization and clinical labels have not been expert-validated.
